caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a high back composed of three curved horizontal slats and vertical posts topped with small finials. The chair has two turned wooden armrests connected to the back posts and front legs, both of which are also turned and cylindrical in shape. The seat is woven with a natural fiber material, forming a slightly textured surface in a light tan color. The rest of the chair, including the legs, uprights, crossbars, and arms, is made of medium brown wood. The chair is positioned on a neutral, off-white background with no other objects or decorations present in the image.
title: Armchair
